rows.label: qst200208_msg0001
rows.name:
Somehow, those honest eyes of yours
remind me of my husband[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200208_msg0002
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]Where is your husband?

rows.label: qst200208_msg0003
rows.name:
Harhal's father[ML:Dash ] He was sent off
to war and died.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0004
rows.name:
All that was left was Harhal
and me, and the debt.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0005
rows.name:
I've always been frail from a chronic
illness, so I couldn't even work
properly.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0006
rows.name:
So we struggled to get by, the debt
kept growing, and I was pushed
to the brink.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0007
rows.name:
A mother and child living alone?
That must have been tough[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200208_msg0008
rows.name:
Then my daughter said she wanted to
dance, even though there was no money
in it.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0009
rows.name:
Because of that, Harhal and I
did nothing but fight every day.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0010
rows.name:
Eventually she couldn't stand poverty,
got fed up with me, and left home.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0011
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]So she became a dancer
at Bahn's place.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0043
rows.name: In the end, it looks like she made it.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0012
rows.name:
That girl sent money every
month for my treatment.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0013
rows.name: Working so hard for someone like me.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0014
rows.name:
I couldn't do anything for her
as a mother, or even support
her dream.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0015
rows.name:
I couldn't make my daughter
happy. I was miserable and
couldn't forgive myself.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0016
rows.name:
Truth is, I want her to be happy.
I want her to dance
to her heart's content.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0017
rows.name:
But as long as I'm here, she can't
achieve that dream. She can't be happy[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200208_msg0018
rows.name:
I don't want her to suffer anymore.
Maybe she'd be better off
if I were gone[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200208_msg0019
rows.name: You idiot!

rows.label: qst200208_msg0020
rows.name:
Do you think Harhal would really
be happy if you were gone?

rows.label: qst200208_msg0021
rows.name:
You're her one and only mother,
you know?

rows.label: qst200208_msg0022
rows.name:
You're the only one who can
watch over her.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0023
rows.name: If you really care about Harhal[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200208_msg0024
rows.name:
No matter what happens, as a mother,
you should watch over your daughter
and live together, don't you think?

rows.label: qst200208_msg0025
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]Yeah, you're right.
I'm her mother. I can't lose heart.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0026
rows.name:
I have to be on her side,
no matter what.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0027
rows.name:
When she comes home, I want to
apologize properly for everything
I've done.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0028
rows.name:
Then I'll ask her to live here
with me again.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0029
rows.name: Yeah, that's good.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0030
rows.name:
Oh, that's right[ML:Dash ]
She hasn't come home, but I did get
a letter from her recently.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0031
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]A letter?

rows.label: qst200208_msg0032
rows.name:
"There is a big deal in the Old
City of Elgria, so I will be able
to get a large sum of money soon."

rows.label: qst200208_msg0033
rows.name:
"After that, I'm coming home."
That's what she wrote.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0034
rows.name:
But I haven't heard from her since.
Who knows when she'll be back[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200208_msg0035
rows.name: That concerns me[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200208_msg0036
rows.name:
Hey... I know I'm in no position
to ask you this, but...

rows.label: qst200208_msg0037
rows.name:
If my daughter is doing something
bad, could you stop her?

rows.label: qst200208_msg0038
rows.name: Yeah, leave it to me!

rows.label: qst200208_msg0039
rows.name:
With my heart of justice,
I will make your daughter
turn over a new leaf.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0040
rows.name:
Then, let's go search for
Harhal in the Old City
of Elgria in Superbia.

rows.label: qst200208_msg0041
rows.name: Please take care of Harhal!

rows.label: qst200208_msg0042
rows.name:
I told you I don't know anything about
that wayward daughter! Leave before
I call someone!
